phase: x,y are pixel coordinates centered on the image; cycles = fy*y + fx*x + dy*y^2/(2*(H-1)) + dx*x^2/(2*(W-1)) + cross*x*y/sqrt((H-1)*(W-1)). Offset in radians from default_rng(seed).uniform(-pi,pi).
observation: clip(reference + amplitude * sin(2*pi*cycles + offset), 0, 1); same added signal before clipping for both photographs
evaluation: Post-clipping observation minus the exact reference defines the added signal. Historical cases verified against archived run and metrics. New realizations reserved for one comparison after the source freeze; photos themselves were used for development.
